gaps.sentence: He was ___ to resign after the scandal.
gaps.explanation: 'be forced to do' = be made to do unwillingly.

gaps.sentence: This is the village ___ my grandmother was born.
The committee meets ___ other month, always on a Tuesday.
gaps.explanation: 'Every other month' = one month yes, one month no.

gaps.sentence: She's the woman ___ helped me find the station.
The meeting has been ___ forward to Monday.
gaps.explanation: 'bring forward' = move to an earlier time (opposite of put off).

gaps.sentence: All the tickets ___ sold out by noon.
gaps.explanation: Past perfect passive: had been + participle (before the stated past moment).
